reputation.dragon.portal: Dragon: The way home is open. Return whenever you wish.

reputation.dragon.help: Dragon: Tell me what you seek, mortal. I am listening.
reputation.dragon.friend: Dragon: Help? Even kings of darkness must pay for it.
reputation.dragon.unknown: Dragon: Friendship is not born from fear.

reputation.dragon.dark_help: Dragon: My eternity is darker than yours.
reputation.dragon.dark_friend: Dragon: I do not serve you, but I will listen.
reputation.dragon.dark_unknown: Dragon: We are not friends. Not yet.
reputation.dragon.dark_extra: Dragon: Darkness has heard your words.
